title: Semilinear purity exchange in the derived coefficient-tower category
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $f:X=X_0\times_{k_0}k\to Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ its base change, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $g_T=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for $T=X,Y$, with $\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q$ geometric Frobenius [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Work on the small pro-etale sites.

Put $A_m=\mathcal O_E/\ell^m$ for $m\geq1$. Use the ordinary derived categories of strict varying-coefficient towers and their uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Let $K_\bullet$ be in the latter category on $Y$, with no normalization assumed. Put $P=g_{Y,\bullet}^*$, $Q=g_{X,\bullet}^*$, $F=Rf_{!,\bullet}\dashv G=f^!_\bullet$ with counit $\varepsilon$ [det-sp-tower-gluing], $H=f_\bullet^*(-)(d)[2d]$, and $\Gamma:H\simeq G$ the natural tower purity map [det-sp-tower-gamma]. Tensor products and twists are ordinary derived tower tensors and levelwise twists. Let $B:PF\simeq FQ$ be compact-support exchange, defined using the retagged $k$-linear Cartesian square with structural maps $\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)\circ a_T$ on its source copies, and identified on the underlying sites [det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. Let $e_K:QGK_\bullet\to GPK_\bullet$ be the transpose of $P(\varepsilon_{K_\bullet})B_{GK_\bullet}^{-1}$. Let $b:QH\simeq HP$ be pullback composition, tensor and shift comparison using the whole roots-of-unity tower comparison $\tau_d$ [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists].

Under the same-compactification and counit-preserving identifications, retagging carries the entire tower orientation and tensor-map transpose for $f$ to those for $f^{\langle\gamma\rangle}$. The maps $B$ and $e$ are natural isomorphisms, preserve normalized towers, and satisfy
$$e_{K_\bullet}\circ Q(\Gamma_{K_\bullet})=\Gamma_{PK_\bullet}\circ b_{K_\bullet},\qquad e_{K_\bullet}=\Gamma_{PK_\bullet}\circ b_{K_\bullet}\circ(Q\Gamma_{K_\bullet})^{-1}.$$
These are equalities of morphisms in the ordinary derived category of towers with quotient-coefficient transitions retained; the exceptional exchange is the counit mate in that category.

proof.text: The actual geometric Frobenius maps are compatible scheme isomorphisms and their square is Cartesian. Transport smoothness and the square along the given compactification equation. All finite-type and Noetherian hypotheses are constructed from pullback stability and the geometric-fiber structural maps.

Instantiate isomorphism_purity_result with this Cartesian square, the supplied arbitrary normalized operations, twists, right adjoint and purity presentation. Its Result supplies every clause of the unchanged TowerGeometricPurityConclusion.
